## Summary

Describe the change and evidence.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets or raw observe payloads; inbox and notebook are redacted.
- [ ] World text is treated as untrusted data.
- [ ] Actions and role allowlists are validated; no unsolicited spam.
- [ ] Workflows do not expose secrets to pull request events.
- [ ] Tests are mocked and no live endpoint was called.
- [ ] Claims cite re-checkable evidence and proof level.
- [ ] Human review requested; no agent merges.
